items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: And Benny Turner was playing piano. Yeah, from my Algears... I always knew he lived in Goodtown.

ctx.x: And Benny Turner was playing piano. Yeah, from my Algears. Yeah. No, not that Benny Turner. That Benny Turner used to be an alto player. No. No, Benny Turner's piano player. Well I thought Benny Turner, I didn't know he lived in Algears. I always knew he lived in Goodtown. He lived in Goodtown one hour. He lived in Goodtown one hour. So he lived in Goodtown one hour. So he had their own impression. But you ain't talking about what you call him, living in Goodtown. Not Benny Turner. They always had living across…
But you ain't talking about what you call living in Goodtown?
